§ 01 · The Program

Real accounts,
real decisions.

From handling a loan application and detecting fraud, to strengthening AML controls, managing insurance claims, and leading digital transformation in financial services, every scenario drops you into a genuine banking situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Fifty-four foundations-focused scenarios and forty-six risk-and-regulation-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real banking judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation a banking, fintech, or insurance professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across lending, fintech, insurance, compliance, and wealth management.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound banking judgment under real pressure.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Banking Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping banking, fintech, and insurance professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in finance isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–B2 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, banking, fintech, and insurance roles in English — Mr. Gad Banking, Fintech & Insurance is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the financial moments you'll actually face.
